description: This file defines a PHP trait VariablesParamRuleCollection within the OrangeHRM project, specifically for the CorporateBranding plugin. It provides a method to generate a collection of parameter validation rules related to theme colors and fonts, utilizing various validation classes and constants for theme parameters.

classes.name: VariablesParamRuleCollection
classes.description: A PHP trait that provides a method to create a collection of parameter validation rules for theme variables such as colors and fonts.

methods.name: getParamRuleCollection
methods.description: Returns a collection of parameter rules for theme-related variables such as primary and secondary colors and fonts.
